name: Evelyn Regner - § 17/2
title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2025
part_text: recalls that the SSM has repeatedly stated that the implementation of the fundamental review of the trading book would strengthen the resilience of EU banks and not undermine their competitiveness;
part_context: Welcomes the finalisation and implementation of the Basel III framework, which will strengthen resilience in the EU; notes that other jurisdictions have pursued a less ambitious implementation agenda; underlines the continued lack of clarity concerning the implementation of the Basel III standards in some other jurisdictions; recalls that the SSM has repeatedly stated that the implementation of the fundamental review of the trading book would strengthen the resilience of EU banks and not undermine their competitiveness; calls on the Commission to review equivalence decisions with jurisdictions not implementing those standards;
